    FROM account
    WHERE date > '1996-01-01'

       SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM district d
JOIN qualifying_districts q ON d.district_id = q.district_id
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id

questions.nlq: What is the total loan amount for all accounts that have a gold card and whose associated client has made at least three transactions in the last two years?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I mean the combined total loan amount summed across all such accounts.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(date) AS maxd FROM trans),
     date_limit AS (SELECT date(maxd, '-2 years') AS limitd FROM max_date),
     gold_accounts AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, d.client_id
         FROM account a
         JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
         JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
         WHERE c.type = 'gold'
     ),
     client_tx AS (
         SELECT cl.client_id
         FROM client cl
         JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
         JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id = d.account_id
         JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = ac.account_id
         JOIN date_limit dl ON 1=1
         WHERE t.date >= dl.limitd
         GROUP BY cl.client_id
         HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) >= 3
     )
SELECT SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ga.account_id
    FROM gold_accounts ga
    JOIN client_tx ct ON ga.client_id = ct.client_id
);

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I mean the total loan amount for each such account, listed per account.

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id AND c.type = 'gold'
JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.client_id IN (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM (
        SELECT d2.client_id, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
        FROM trans t
        JOIN disp d2 ON t.account_id = d2.account_id
        WHERE t.date >= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM trans), '-2 years')
        GROUP BY d2.client_id
    )
    WHERE txn_count >= 3
)
GROUP BY a.account_id;

    JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
    GROUP BY c.type, d.client_id
)

GROUP BY type

questions.nlq: Hey! I'm doing some financial analysis and could really use your help here. Can you figure out the cumulative deposit totals for all the districts going back to 1996, and let me know which periods saw the biggest jump in activity?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I mean the cumulative total of deposits across the entire bank system treating all districts as one big pool, so I want to see the peaks in the overall national activity.

SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS period,
    SUM(amount) AS period_total,
    SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)) AS cumulative_total
FROM trans
WHERE type = 'PRIJEM' 
    AND date >= '1996-01-01'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)
ORDER BY cumulative_total;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I actually need a separate cumulative tracking for each individual district, so I can compare which specific region showed the biggest spike in deposits relative to its own history.

WITH district_deposits AS (
    SELECT 
        a.district_id,
        strftime('%Y', t.date) AS year_period,
        SUM(t.amount) AS period_deposit
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM' 
      AND t.date >= '1996-01-01'
    GROUP BY a.district_id, strftime('%Y', t.date)
),
cumulative_tracking AS (
    SELECT 
        district_id,
        year_period,
        period_deposit,
        SUM(period_deposit) OVER (
            PARTITION BY district_id 
            ORDER BY year_period
        ) AS cumulative_deposit_total,
        LAG(period_deposit) OVER (
            PARTITION BY district_id 
            ORDER BY year_period
        ) AS previous_period_deposit,
        period_deposit - COALESCE(
            LAG(period_deposit) OVER (
                PARTITION BY district_id 
                ORDER BY year_period
            ), 0
        ) AS jump_in_activity
    FROM district_deposits
)
SELECT 
    district_id,
    year_period,
    period_deposit,
    cumulative_deposit_total,
    jump_in_activity
FROM cumulative_tracking
WHERE jump_in_activity > 0
ORDER BY jump_in_activity DESC;

WITH avg_bal AS (SELECT AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM "trans"),
     gold_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_cards FROM "card" WHERE type = 'gold'),

         SELECT l."date" AS loan_date,
                l.payments - (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_bal) AS adj_payment
         FROM "loan" l
     )
SELECT 
       SUM(adj_payment) OVER (ORDER BY loan_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total_adjusted,
       (SELECT gold_cards FROM gold_count) AS total_active_gold_cards
FROM loan_adj
ORDER BY loan_date;

WITH loan_data AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        l.date,
        l.payments,
        SUM(l.payments) OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_payments
    FROM "loan" l
),
account_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM "card" c
         JOIN "disp" d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
         WHERE d.account_id = a.account_id
           AND c.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards
    FROM "account" a
    LEFT JOIN "trans" t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
)

    ld.cum_payments * a.avg_balance AS adjusted_running_total,
    a.gold_cards AS total_active_gold_cards
FROM loan_data ld
JOIN account_stats a ON ld.account_id = a.account_id
ORDER BY ld.date;

        SELECT d.district_id

               l.status,

    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE d.account_id = a.account_id

      AND c.issued > DATE('1996-01-01')
  )
GROUP BY a.district_id;
